behaviour: The Lab check workflow's post job installs every third party distribution that the module it runs with python -m imports at module level, followed through every local scripts, hooks and tests module that import reaches; imports inside function bodies and under TYPE_CHECKING are not required. A workflow whose install step misses one names the module and the local module importing it, and a workflow that runs no python -m entry is refused.
seam: tests.contracts.test_lab_check_installs.missing_installs over .github/workflows/lab-check.yml and the scripts.ci_lab.checks import closure
